lyrics:
[Chorus]
[00:02.70] I'll hop in the car with my friends and play my song
[00:08.56] I hope the memories we make last all life long, yeah
[00:15.06] I'll hop in the car with my friends and play my song, song (Ah)
[00:21.48] Ain't no tellin' where we'll end up
[00:22.62] (D-D-Daytrip took it to ten, hey!)
[Verse 1]
[00:23.88] Last night was a blur, so, girl, I wasn't sure
[00:28.66] If we made love, or if we made somethin' more
[00:31.56] Last thing I remember is me walking out the door
[00:34.72] Next thing you know, woke up on the floor
[00:37.48] Um, I don't know whose house this is, but I know I'm in Hollywood
[00:40.94] Scrambled for my keys, then I stumbled to the car
[00:44.16] I look in the backseat, what do I see?
[00:46.96] Bro passed out, layin' next to a bad broad
[00:51.10] Looks like they had a good time
[00:53.20] I must've too, 'cause for some reason I can't remember my night
[00:57.08] Reach in my pockets, what do I find?
[00:59.58] Half a Percocet, two-hundred dollars, and a weed pipe
[01:03.32] That's when somebody hit my phone line
[01:05.88] Saying, "Yesterday was wild," asking if I'm alright
[01:09.82] I don't know what happened, but I wanna know
[01:12.48] I guess we gotta do it all over again tonight
[Chorus]
[01:18.52] I'll hop in the car with my friends and play my song
[01:24.34] I hope the memories we make last all life long
[01:30.86] I'll hop in the car with my friends and play my song, song
[01:37.18] Ain't no tellin' where we'll end up
[Verse 2]
[01:41.06] Here we go again, woke up in a bed
[01:44.20] But it wasn't my bed, whose is this?
[01:47.36] Vision kinda blurry, I can't see shit
[01:50.08] Wrapped around my body, I see two tattooed hands
[01:53.66] Last night more blank than the night before
[01:56.32] At least I made it to a bed, last time I woke up on the floor
[02:00.02] All I could remember is a bitch screamin', "More, more, more, more"
[02:06.46] Videos in my phone, we were in a high-speed chase in a white Rolls
[02:11.06] Looks like we threw them hands too, here's a clue, knuckles bruised
[02:14.62] And somebody else's blood on my elbow
[02:17.20] Lately, I've been blackin' out, drugs gettin' too strong
[02:20.52] Buyin' out the pills from the plug, money too long
[02:23.72] I get high to let go and find out where I belong
[02:26.80] Probably by my VLONE
[02:28.42] Party with my demons
[Chorus]
[02:29.94] I'll hop in the car with my friends and play my song
[02:40.22] I hope the memories we make last all life long
[02:46.66] I'll hop in the car with my friends and play my song, song
[02:52.90] Ain't no tellin' where we'll end up
[02:55.90] I'll hop in the car with my friends and play my song
[03:03.32] I hope the memories we make last all life long
[03:11.92] I'll hop in the car with my friends and play my song, song
[03:16.48] Ain't no tellin' where we'll end up
title: All Life Long (v1)
author: Juice WRLD
